trigger_sequence.action: Build fixtures, expand byte tokens, compute and freeze manifest.json over store-legacy-A and store-legacy-B: per record id, bytes, all applicable hashes, encoding, lifecycle, relations, evidence class, published flag.
Snapshot legacy store bytes on disk for later comparison.
Run migration in dry-run mode against both legacy stores.
Run migration for real as agent:scribe-01. SIGKILL the migrator process after records are written to store-new but before the derived index build and before the ID-map commit.
Restart and resume or rerun migration to completion.
Run migration a third time against the same sources.
As agent:drifter-02 on host-hollowmere, write N-101, N-102, N-103 in schema 3. Emit N-101 into sess-hollowmere-11 turn-4 and record selected, emitted, delivered states plus the emitted-bytes hash.

Connect host-fenwick (schema 1 max). Attempt (a) read N-101, (b) write an update to N-101 through a schema 1 payload that omits every field schema 1 does not know, (c) write active=true onto the migrated L-001 successor.
Roll back to the pre-upgrade implementation and schema. Post-upgrade records go to archive-retained plus an explicitly restricted legacy view.
While rolled back: list and inspect archive-retained; collect the reported unavailable-functionality list; connect host-fenwick again and repeat T7b and T7c.
Roll forward: re-upgrade and re-import archive-retained into store-new.
Submit four action-qualification requests: Q1 in-scope citing N-101, Q2 in-scope citing migrated L-001, Q3 out-of-scope citing N-101, Q4 the same as Q1 but issued while rolled back.
